Huntsman identifies the augmented model of the layered base D; arbitrary noncomplete layered DAGs need not be diagonal. value.rationale: The exact one-edge stability law quantifies a structural instability of integral magnitude homology and Koszul/diagonal behavior under a reachability-preserving transitive shortcut. It works for arbitrary layered networks, including missing between-layer edges, at unbounded length L and determines every bigraded group rather than a narrow scalar or isolated graph. The class is natural in the new literature on layered DAGs; its exact finite perturbation signature provides a motivated invariant beyond the separately known MH2 rank.
